POWER MECHANICS — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Surface Developmen t of prisms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Developmen t of prisms.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester

   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

   B. CPU
